comment: Maja is a very caring and relatable professor. The class is definitely a bit of work and outside time (lab hours/projects) but all worth it, I have learned so much.

Maja is one of my favorite professors. Definitely take this class if you have the chance. Learned a lot about light in her class.

Maja is a fantastic professor who cares so much about her students. She is always ready to help out students who seek her help. Though Maja is an amazing teacher, I would not recommend this class to students who are not sincerely interested in the topic.
